content.text:
I finished all five items. The work is in two local commits (not pushed), and all the checks I ran pass. Re-read with the new statistic, the 09-21 E7 pair no longer promotes: it comes out `inconclusive`.

**Setup:** my worktree had been created from `master`, which doesn't have `packages/improvement` or `data/`. I fast-forwarded its branch to `claude/coding-agent-harness-u9l4gt` (0235dc01e). No commits were lost, because the branch had none of its own.

- **Worktree:** `/home/user/deepseek-harness/.claude/worktrees/agent-a1fb361c0794f327e`
- **Branch:** `worktree-agent-a1fb361c0794f327e`
- **Commits:**
  - `8cbccfb064ff165c856b2b02d5975e014f375ab4`: the statistic fix, the guard, the ledger field, docs, and the Agent Note.
  - `7d897c8cde7a3fc4ae68ebbeabca8680437efee4`: the re-read tool, the two folds, and the records README.

**Re-read numbers**

| Reading | Baseline | Candidate | Delta | Discordant pairs | Interval | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 09-21 pair as recorded (`paired-bootstrap/0`) | 12/16 | 14/16 | +0.125 | 2 | [0.125, 0.125] | promote |
| 09-21 pair re-read (`paired-cluster-bootstrap/1`) | 12/16 | 14/16 | +0.125 | 2 | [0, 0.375] | inconclusive, decided by the interval |
| Three E7 pairs pooled | 41/48 | 43/48 | +0.042 | 6 | [−0.083, 0.1875] | inconclusive, decided by the interval |

- **The discordant guard does not fire on 09-21.** That pair has exactly 2 discordant pairs, which meets the default minimum of 2. The cluster interval alone is what makes it inconclusive: about a third of resamples leave out the one environment that flipped (`code:conf-canon`).
- **The per-repetition pairs were rebuilt from each record's `facts.jsonl`,** because `result.json` only holds per-environment rates. For all three records the rebuild reproduced every recorded cell: pair counts, both arms' certificates, and each environment's interval redrawn under the record's own digest.
- **The first 09-19 pair has a different digest** only because the plan format moved from 6 to 7 when the preset field was added. Its arms, caps, environments and thresholds are identical to the other two.

**What changed besides the statistic**
- **Every plan digest changes.** Adding `minimumDiscordantPairs` to the digest moves the plan format from 7 to 8. A caller holding a format-7 digest will be refused, and the experiment-presets snapshot was refreshed for the new digest.
- **Results say why they are inconclusive.** Besides `statistic`, each result now carries `discordantPairs` and `verdictBasis` (`interval`, `no-pairs` or `too-few-discordant-pairs`).
- **Ledger lines carry `statistic`, and the decision rule is unchanged.** Lines written before this read as `paired-bootstrap/0`. The dashboard's Loop section shows the statistic next to the interval; I only changed the template, so `dashboard.html` updates at the next rebuild.
- **The re-read tool** is `reread-driver.ts` next to `fold-driver.ts`, run directly with tsx. I did not add a `bench reread` subcommand. It refuses to overwrite an existing file. No record, ledger line or `improvement-log.md` was touched.
- **One test failure that predates this work:** a `scripts/proving-ground.spec.ts` test expected a record name that the loop's second 09-19 E7 record had already taken. I pinned it to a past date whose records can no longer change.

**Commands and results**
- `pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`: ok. The e2e needed the terminal native module (node-pty), which the install hadn't built, so I built it locally; nothing from that is committed.
- `pnpm vitest run packages/improvement/experiments`: 48/48 pass.
- Coverage: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/improvement/experiments --coverage --coverage.include='packages/improvement/experiments/src/**/*.ts'` gives 100% on every file. The literal `pnpm run test:coverage -- <path>` measures every package's `src`, so it would fail the 100% threshold on untouched packages.
- `vitest run scripts/proving-ground.spec.ts`: 70/70. The observatory specs: 44/44. The experiments e2e: 2/2.
